title: Daily Pokemon sales value on TCGplayer
caption: Daily observed Pokemon item-value bounds on TCGplayer, across English and Japanese catalog products. Bounds sum SKU-day quantities multiplied by actual low/high unit sale prices; they are not a confidence interval or exact revenue. Shipping and tax are excluded. Only closed source dates supported by verified catalog sweeps and complete price coverage are plotted. Unverified dates and incomplete prices are retained in the CSV; gaps are not zero sales. A catalog sweep is not a certified marketplace total.
alt: Pokemon sales value from 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-17. 40 retained dates not shown: newest or without a verified catalog sweep. Latest collection sweep: 8,644 / 63,939 products checked; 1 failed. 0 dates omitted for incomplete prices.
